visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard is seen in a close-up on the left side of the frame, while a woman with dark hair tied up stands in the background wearing a loose grey t-shirt. They are in a brightly lit indoor living space with a green sofa and a red exercise ball visible. The woman gestures with her hands as she speaks. (2) The scene cuts to the woman now wearing a black ribbed tank top and grey flared leggings. She is standing in a room filled with cardboard boxes, suggesting a move. She adjusts her hair and jewelry. (3) Transition to an airport setting where the woman and three young children are on a descending escalator. The children wave at the camera. The lighting is bright and industrial. (4) The woman is now outdoors on an airport tarmac next to an orange and white airplane. She wears a grey zip-up hoodie over her tank top. She turns around to show the fit of the clothing. (5) A new phase shows the woman indoors in a different setting, wearing a beige short-sleeved top and matching flared pants. She turns to the side and back, highlighting a cutout design on the rear of the top. (6) The woman is seen walking through busy urban streets in London, holding hands with the children. She is wearing the grey hoodie. They pass by various storefronts including a Lululemon shop. (7) Back indoors, the woman and man are together; she is in a blue tank top and he is in a blue t-shirt. They stand in a kitchen area. (8) The woman rolls out a dark green yoga mat on a wooden floor and performs several yoga poses, including downward dog and cobra. The man attempts a pose behind her but appears to struggle, creating a humorous moment. (9) A screen recording shows a mobile browser navigating the Lululemon website, displaying various clothing items and the checkout process with Taiwanese currency (NT$). (10) The final shot shows the couple together again, smiling and laughing as the man playfully nudges the woman.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main woman has long dark hair and wears various Lululemon outfits including t-shirts, tank tops, hoodies, and flared leggings. The man has a shaved head and short beard, wearing casual athletic t-shirts and shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a home interior with moving boxes, a busy international airport terminal, the tarmac next to an EasyJet aircraft, and various historic street corners in London.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM track. A female voice speaks with high energy in Mandarin, followed by a male voice mimicking her. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual jump cut. The female voice continues with a fast speech rate, describing clothing sets. (3) Background noise shifts to a crowded public space with audible chatter and laughter. High-pitched children's voices are heard yelling 'Hi'. (4) The scene transitions with a 'pop' sound effect. Ambient noise of an airplane engine hum is briefly audible. (5) On 'Day 2', the BGM maintains its tempo. The woman's voice remains clear and informative. (6) A camera shutter sound effect is used during the London street montage. (7) During the yoga segment, the sound of a mat rolling (friction) is heard, followed by a loud, sudden laugh from the male voice as he falls. (8) The final segment features a clearer, more narrative vocal tone as the woman explains website features, with the BGM dipping slightly in volume to prioritize the speech.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Outfit 1 (Travel) -> Outfit 2 (London Walk) -> Outfit 3 (Yoga) -> Brand Purchasing Info -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Lululemon activewear by demonstrating its versatility through a three-day travel and lifestyle vlog, highlighting comfort, style, and ease of purchase for Taiwanese customers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand, display of specific product names, and a detailed explanation of how to purchase from the brand's website including shipping and tax information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production-value social media content utilizing fast-paced editing and family dynamics to increase engagement for a fashion brand.
